title: Transmutable
summary: TRANSMU'TABLE, adjective [from transmute.] Capable of being changed into a different substance, or into something of a different form or nature. The fluids and solids of an animal body are transmutabl

inlines.v: TRANSMU'TABLE, adjective [from transmute.] Capable of being changed into a different substance, or into something of a different form or nature. The fluids and solids of an animal body are transmutable into one another.
